newsitem.title: UK: UK shares fall as rate rise, Dow unnerve market.
newsitem.headline: UK shares fall as rate rise, Dow unnerve market.

text.p: UK shares closed at their lowest levels for a month on Friday after the latest economic indicators failed to inspire investors who preferred to dwell on Wednesday's rate hike and a jittery performance in New York.
"The market is suffering from a hangover after the interest rate rise," added Credit Lyonnais Laing analyst Corey Miller.
The FTSE 100 index finished slightly off the day's worst levels, to be down 30.6 points at 3,948.5. A net 74-points lower on the week. Losers outweighed gainers by roughly four times.
"There are some nerves about the U.S. but basically it's a classic consolidation," said SBC Warburg's George Hodgson.
